meta.title: Security — Torta CRM
meta.description: How we keep your data, your customers and your team safe.

hero.title: Built to keep your data yours
hero.subtitle: We take data protection as seriously as our customers do. Here's exactly what's in place — for every account, starting from Free.

pillars.title: The basics, done right
pillars.subtitle: Defaults you don't have to think about — they're on for every account.

encryption.title: Encryption everywhere
encryption.desc: All traffic to Torta uses TLS 1.2 or newer. Data at rest in our database and file storage is encrypted with AES-256. Backups are encrypted before they leave the server.

isolation.title: Multi-tenant isolation
isolation.desc: Every project sits in its own scope. A query scoped to project A cannot read or write data from project B — enforced at the database layer, not just in application code.

passwords.title: Hashed passwords
passwords.desc: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt using a per-user salt. We can never see your password or your customers' passwords, and a leaked database dump would not expose them.

rbac.title: Roles & permissions
rbac.desc: Page-level RBAC means you decide exactly what each teammate can see and change. A staff role can manage Orders without ever seeing Revenue or Customer Profiles.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.subtitle: Where your data lives and who has access to it.

hosting.title: EU data centres
hosting.desc: Servers are hosted with IONOS SE in Germany — a GDPR-compliant infrastructure provider. Data does not leave the EU except where you explicitly use a third-party integration that does.

email.title: Self-hosted email
email.desc: Outbound email goes through our own DKIM-signed mail server. We don't relay through a third party for transactional or campaign email — your customer addresses don't end up in a marketing partner's database.

access.title: Strict admin access
access.desc: Only a small number of named operators have shell access to production infrastructure. All access is logged and reviewed.

backups.title: Daily encrypted backups
backups.desc: The database is backed up daily with rolling 30-day retention. Backups are encrypted at rest and tested for restorability on a regular schedule.

compliance.title: Compliance & privacy
compliance.subtitle: What we promise and where to read the legal version.

gdpr.title: GDPR-aligned
gdpr.desc: We follow GDPR principles for any user in the EU/EEA: lawful basis, data minimisation, the right to access, correction, deletion and portability.

kzPdpa.title: Kazakhstan ЗоПД
kzPdpa.desc: Compliant with the Republic of Kazakhstan's Personal Data Protection Act. Storage and processing follow the local rules for cross-border data transfer.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Every administrative action on your data is logged with who, what and when. Useful for your own internal compliance, and available if an auditor or regulator asks.

subprocessors.title: Limited sub-processors
subprocessors.desc: We use a small, named list of sub-processors (Paddle for payments, Google for optional OAuth, IONOS for infrastructure). Each is bound by contract — no surprise data sharing.

incident.title: If something goes wrong
incident.body: No system is unbreakable. Our commitment is transparency: if we discover a security incident that affects your data, we will notify you within 72 hours of confirmation, explain what happened, what data was involved, and what we are doing about it.
incident.report: Found a vulnerability? Please report it responsibly to {{email}}. We acknowledge every report within 5 business days.

cta.title: Ready to run your store on safer ground?
cta.subtitle: Start free and check it out for yourself. Upgrade only when you need more.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every device where you're signed in. Revoking ends that session immediately.

about.title: About sessions
about.subtitle: How staying logged in works.
about.text: A session is created every time you sign in (email code, Google, etc). Each one is a short-lived access token (15 min) plus a long-lived refresh token (30 days) — your browser silently swaps an expired access token for a new one, so you stay logged in transparently. If you suspect someone has access to your account, log out from all devices and change your password.
